mentions.name: Goofy conversation-starter t-shirt store
mentions.description: An online t-shirt store selling goofy, funny t-shirts designed to spark conversations and help the wearer meet people, preparing for launch in the next few weeks.
mentions.problem: The builder had trouble meeting people after moving to a new city.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm preparing my t-shirt store for launch soon.

I was having trouble meeting people after moving to a new city so I designed and printed some goofy funny t-shirts for my wardrobe, and that has really helped on getting the ball rolling on conversations.

Hoping to make the launch within the next few weeks.
